proposition: Late letters greet Sufi shaykhs in Herat and Central Asia: Ḥasan ʿAṭṭār (36, Naqshbandī), Qāsim-i Anvār (37, 38 after several days in his company, dated 830/1427 or 834/1431), Bahāʾ al-Dīn (39), Mīr Makhdūm (40), two unnamed Sufis (45) and Ẓāfir al-Dīn (47).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Sufi shaykhs
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Addressee identifications of 39 are 'possibly' per MK; date of 38 is queried
